documents.title: Rare Disease FY2026 Planning Guidance
documents.excerpt: FY2026 rare disease net sales envelope set at USD 8.5B. Planning to move from the standalone Anaplan model onto the finance semantic layer on Snowflake as part of the platform consolidation programme.

documents.title: Eculizumab Biosimilar Tender Tracker — Europe
documents.excerpt: Biosimilar eculizumab now listed in national tenders across several EU markets. Remaining Soliris PNH patients concentrated in long-term stable regimens; switch rate to biosimilar below early forecasts.

documents.title: gMG Claims Analysis — Diagnosis-to-Treatment Time
documents.excerpt: US claims data shows median time from gMG diagnosis to complement inhibitor start fell from 14 to 9 months. AChR+ antibody testing in community neurology up 22% YoY.

documents.title: FcRn Competitive Landscape Update
documents.excerpt: FcRn blocker uptake in gMG slower than modelled in the FY2025 plan. Ultomiris retains share in AChR+ generalised MG with 8-weekly maintenance dosing as key differentiator.

documents.title: Koselugo China NRDL Listing
documents.excerpt: Koselugo listed on the National Reimbursement Drug List effective January. 38 additional tertiary hospitals onboarded for paediatric NF1-PN; provincial formulary uptake ahead of Ultomiris precedent.

documents.title: Adult HPP Screening Programme Results
documents.excerpt: Low alkaline phosphatase screening flagged 410 undiagnosed adult HPP candidates across partner health systems. Estimated 30% conversion to Strensiq therapy over 18 months.

documents.title: US Gross-to-Net Outlook — IRA & 340B
documents.excerpt: Medicaid mix for Strensiq up 3pp on paediatric enrolment; 340B contract pharmacy volume rising. FY2026 blended US GTN expected +1.2pp vs FY2025.

documents.title: EU Joint Clinical Assessment Readiness
documents.excerpt: Joint Clinical Assessment timelines plus national HTA re-assessments create 4-6% net price pressure for complement inhibitors in Europe. Managed entry agreement templates from aHUS reusable for gMG.

documents.title: Voydeya Add-on Uptake — EVH Patients
documents.excerpt: 24% of eligible Ultomiris PNH patients with clinically significant extravascular haemolysis screened for Voydeya add-on. Haematologist awareness up after congress data.

documents.title: Planning Platform Containment Memo
documents.excerpt: Containment mode: no net-new finance platforms. Rare disease planning pilot to run on existing Snowflake actuals and the finance semantic layer, retiring one standalone planning platform.
